title: Holi Outfit for Cold Weather: UK and Canada Style Guide 2027
excerpt: Playing Holi in a cold UK or Canadian March? How to layer thermals under a kurta, pick a jacket you can stain and choose shoes for wet ground.
body:
For a cold-weather Holi, wear a cotton kurta or tunic over a thin thermal base layer, add leggings or palazzos with thermals underneath, and finish with an old jacket and closed shoes you are happy to stain. Keep the festive layer on top so your photos still look like Holi, not a winter hike.

This guide is for women in the UK and Canada, where Holi falls in late March 2027 (check your local calendar) and the weather can swing from crisp sunshine to sleet in a day. An easy base is a $27 [coral pink hand block print cotton tunic top](/products/coral-pink-hand-block-print-cotton-tunic-top/) over thermal leggings.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Our block prints are hand printed by karigars, and our pieces are made in our own Jaipur unit.*

## What should you wear to Holi when it is cold outside?

Think of your outfit in three parts. The base keeps you warm, the middle is the Indian outfit everyone sees, and the outer layer takes the worst of the colour and the wind.

The middle layer should be cotton and a little roomy. A fitted kurta over a thermal looks tight and bulky, while a straight or A-line cut with some ease sits smoothly. Hip-length tunics and calf-length kurtas both work; just avoid floor-length hems that will drag through wet grass.

For bottoms, palazzos or straight pants are easier than churidars because a pair of thermal leggings slips underneath without anyone knowing.

## How do you layer thermals under a kurta without looking bulky?

Choose thin, fitted thermals in a neutral or skin-tone shade, with a scoop or round neck that sits lower than your kurta neckline. Long sleeves under three-quarter sleeves look neat if the colours are close. We cover the full layering method in our guide on [how to layer Indian outfits in winter abroad](/blog/how-to-layer-indian-outfits-in-winter-abroad/), so here is the short Holi version.

Keep the thermal smooth and the kurta loose. Tuck the thermal top into the thermal leggings so no gap appears when you bend or throw colour. If the kurta has side slits, the thermal underneath should be a similar shade to your pants.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** If you plan to wear a thermal underneath, take your measurements over that thermal, not over a T-shirt. It is a small step, but it means the kurta we stitch for you sits with the right ease. Hand block printed cotton is soft and light, so it layers well without adding weight.

## What jacket and shoes should you wear to play Holi in the cold?

The jacket is your shield. Pick an old denim jacket, a cheap rain shell or a fleece you are ready to retire. Avoid wool coats, down jackets and anything dry-clean only, because powder works into the fibres and rarely comes out.

Here is a simple guide by place:

| Where you are | Base layer | Outfit | Outer layer | Shoes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| London and southern England | Thin thermal top and leggings | Cotton kurta set or tunic | Rain shell | Closed trainers |
| Northern England and Scotland | Thermal plus a fitted long-sleeve top | Kurta palazzo set | Fleece or old puffer | Waterproof trainers |
| Toronto and Montreal | Heavier thermals | Roomy cotton kurta set | Old winter jacket | Ankle boots with grip |
| Vancouver | Thin thermals | Co-ord set or tunic | Waterproof shell | Waterproof trainers |

For your feet, keep it practical:

- Closed shoes with grip, never sandals
- Dark wool socks, because pale socks stain fast
- A spare pair of socks in a plastic bag
- Old shoes you do not need to save

## Which Indian outfits work best for a cold-weather Holi?

### Option 1: Tunic over thermal leggings

The lightest and cheapest route. A block print tunic hides colour splashes, layers over a thermal easily and costs $27, so you can save a second one for the drive home.

### Option 2: A printed co-ord with layers underneath

The [cotton floral printed top and wide leg palazzo co-ord set](/products/women-s-cotton-floral-printed-top-wide-leg-palazzo-set-two-piece-co-ord-set/) at $36 has wide legs that make room for thermals. It feels modern, which suits a younger crowd or a mixed group of friends.

For a family or community Holi, the [mint green hand block print cotton kurta pant dupatta set with hand work yoke](/products/mint-green-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-set-with-hand-work-yoke/) at $48 is a festive pick. Mint is a soft spring shade that makes pink and yellow gulal look bright. Leave the dupatta indoors if it is windy.

## How can you plan around the weather on the day?

Check the forecast the night before and agree a plan with your group. Many groups play with dry gulal only when it is cold, keep coloured water for a warmer year, or move part of the party indoors.

Keep a warm, clean outfit in the car or at the host's house, with a towel and a bag for wet clothes. Changing quickly once play ends makes the lunch afterwards much more enjoyable.

Be kind to neighbours too: lay sheets on driveways and keep colour off cars and fences.

## Frequently asked questions

**What should I wear under a kurta to stay warm for Holi?**
A thin, fitted thermal top and thermal leggings in a neutral shade. Choose a kurta with a little ease so the layer does not show.

**Can I wear a jacket over a kurta for Holi?**
Yes, and in the UK or Canada you probably should. Pick an old denim jacket or rain shell that you do not mind staining.

**Is it okay to play Holi with only dry colours when it is cold?**
Absolutely. Plenty of groups skip coloured water in cold weather and play with dry gulal only. Agree on it with your group beforehand.

**How do I wash coloured powder out of my Holi outfit?**
Shake off dry powder outside, rinse in cold water and wash separately. Avoid hot water at first, as it can help colour settle into cotton.
